decisions.statement: A session already there on the same simulator is reused.
An identity is put in before a route is navigated to.
A call saying nothing about identity signs in as the throwaway.
Nothing is changed through Alan's own identity.
The webview is taken hold of again after a navigation.
An opening that threw part way names in its refusal what it had already done.
A call naming no simulator takes the session's own simulator or the first booted simulator.
An Appium server this started and a simulator this booted are named in the refusal.
An Appium server started is named before the wait for it to answer.

definition: the command opening a route in the simulator and leaving a session at it
